A '''battle''' was fought between the [[Kingdom of Cron]] of [[Pirate King/Legends|Pirate King]] [[Xer VIII|Xer]] and the [[Back Spiral]] in the [[Pre-Republic era]], at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]].

Following the [[Battle of Chandaar|defeat]] of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ferece]], Xer installed himself as the new [[King of Cron]] and launched a series of campaigns to take control of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. After have conquered the complete Kingdom of Cron and defeated the [[Three Allied Kingdoms]], Xer attacked the worlds of the so-called Back Spiral. After his victores at [[Caluula/Legends|Caluula]] and Brigia, Xer moved to [[Tion]].<ref name="Xim Week" />
